children.statement: Calculate the correctness of the model
Correct construction of effective Hamiltonian operator

children.issue: The code correctly constructs the spin one model.
The code correctly constructs the nearest neighbour Heisenberg terms in Hamiltonian, S_i*S_j, with coefficient cos(\theta).
The code correctly constructs the nearest neighbour biquadratic terms in Hamiltonian, (S_i*S_j)^2, with coefficient sin(\theta).
The Hamiltonian has been correctly constructed for a spin chain of length L under open boundary conditions.
The code correctly constructs the nematic filed term in Hamiltonian, (S_i^z)^2-(S_i^x)^2, with coefficient \lambda

The code correctly defines the nematic susceptibility \Chi_{nem}, which is the second derivative of the ground state energy with respect to parameter \lambda. The nematic susceptibility is calculated by -(E_0(\lambda)-2*E_0(0)+E_0(-\lambda))/\lambda^2, where E_0 is the ground state enregy.
The code uses DMRG to obtain the ground states of the system.
The code uses ITensors and ITensorMPS packages to calculate
The bond dimension is set to be at least 140 for \theta > -0.73\pi and at least 250 for \theta < -0.73\pi.
The sweep number set at least to be 40.
The calculations are performed for different system sizes, the code ONLY choose L = 16, 32, 48.
